'''Catrine''' is a maid at [[The Nine Rings (inn)]] in [[Tremonsien]].

==Activities==
She serves [[Rand]], [[Hurin]], [[Loial]] and [[Selene]] when they are on their way to Cairhien.{{ref/book|2|21}}

She drops a lamp, just as [[Aldrin Caldevwin]] begins to question Selene.{{ref|Likely caused by Selene to avoid being questioned}}
